steps.name: explain-db
steps.summary: 새 마이그레이션(word_explanations, word_explained 이벤트, 예약·실패·저장 RPC). db/learning.ts: getWord(id)→ExplainWord|null; beginWordExplanation(userId,wordId,choice)→cached{explanation}|reserved{eventId}, 거부 NOT_FOUND·CONSENT_REQUIRED·ONBOARDING_REQUIRED·LIMIT_REACHED·AI_FAILURE_LIMIT; failWordExplanation(userId,eventId,reason); saveWordExplanation(wordId,choice,explanation)→NOT_FOUND 가능. 복습 choice는 "". FREE_DAILY_EXPLANATIONS=10(plan.ts). fakes: getWord "I {{went}} to school.", begin reserved eventId 1.

steps.name: explain-api
steps.summary: POST /api/words/explain(route.ts, maxDuration 60, ready) body {word_id 1~50, choice? 1~50} → 200 {explanation}(WordExplainResponse). 400 INVALID_INPUT(zod·그 단어 보기 아님), 401, 403 CONSENT/ONBOARDING, 404 단어 없음, 429 LIMIT_REACHED(공용 문구), 429 AI_FAILURE_LIMIT(EXPLAIN_FAILURE_LIMIT_MESSAGE), 503 AI_UNAVAILABLE(EXPLAIN_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE). 두 문구는 server/learning.ts export. http.ts Outcome에 message? 추가. ai.generateExplanation(services/claude), fakes 기본값 {explanation:"과거의 일이라 went를 써요."}.

steps.name: explain-ui
steps.summary: 새 WordExplanation.tsx(+test): ExplanationBlock {limit}|{failure-limit,message}, props wordId·choice?·label·showFurigana·trial·block·onBlock·onTrialStarted. 버튼→WaitingDots→설명(bg-mint, Furigana)/오류+[다시 시도]/한도·실패10회 안내, 언마운트 뒤 응답 버림. TrialButton·ProButton tone?: primary|outline. BlankQuiz explanation?(choice)(learn 채점 뒤만), Flashcard revealed?(뒷면 본 뒤부터, 앞면이면 hidden). 회차 429는 WordSession explainBlock(start()·체험 시작에서 null). 빈칸 [왜 정답이에요?]+choice, review 카드만 [예문 설명]. API·docs·LevelTestRunner 변경 없음.
